Subject: POC access & success criteria — Redwood POC next steps

Thanks again for the call today, Alex — great to meet you and the Nimbus team. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC started this week. Please reply with any corrections.

POC goals / success criteria (proposed)
- Run representative billing queries (latency target: p95 < 300ms) against a 6-month dataset.
- Validate cost-per-1k tokens estimates with your sample workload (generate + embeddings).
- End-to-end flow: ingest -> prompt -> output -> downstream scoring for 1000 synthetic transactions.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 1 (this week): Access & provisioning (API sandbox, SSO invites, IP allowlist) -> baseline smoke tests.
- Week 2: Performance runs + cost sampling; surface any model/quantization recs.
- Week 3: Wrap-up, deliver findings, decision meeting.

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (program lead) + Dev (SE, provisioning & test harness).
- Nimbus: Alex (product owner) + IT (access/IP).

Immediate asks from Nimbus:
1) Provide SSO domain and IdP contact for SAML/SCIM invites.
2) Confirm public IP ranges that need allowlisting for test agents (if any).
3) List 2–3 test users to receive SSO invites or let us know if you prefer API keys only.

I've attached a short MOP (redwood-poc-mop.pdf) with the steps we'll execute during the POC. Once we have the SSO domain/IPs/test users, Dev will provision sandbox API keys and SSO invites.

Next step: Alex, if you can reply with the above by EOD Wed (May 13), we can target sandbox access by Thu. If procurement needs to be looped in earlier, Vivek will coordinate.

Thanks —

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick responses, this makes provisioning straightforward. Implementation notes & what we'll need from your side: 

1) Sandbox API key
- I will create a sandbox project in Redwood and generate a scoped API key limited to the POC dataset. Key will be delivered via secure link to Alex and your IT contact unless you prefer SSO-only.

2) SSO / SAML
- We support Okta SAML and SCIM for provisioning. For SAML invites, please provide: IdP metadata URL or the IdP entity ID + ACS URL (if you prefer to send metadata, that works).
- For SCIM (optional), we'll need an admin API token from your Okta tenant to sync test users. If you prefer to invite users manually, we can skip SCIM for the pilot.

3) IP allowlist
- If your security team requires source IP allowlisting, our sandbox egress for this POC will come from the following ranges: 34.216.48.0/24, 52.203.120.0/22 (these are temporary test endpoints). Confirm with IT and let us know which to add.

4) Test harness & artifacts
- I'll push a small test harness repo and a set of sample prompts for the 1000 synthetic transactions; link will be shared in next message.

I've attached SSO invite instructions for Okta to help your IT team (sso-invite-instructions.pdf). I'll provision the API key once we have the IdP metadata or confirmation to use API-only.

Thanks —
